evals.prompt: I want to start making a video but I'm not sure what angle to take yet. Can you kick off researcher for me?
evals.expected_output: Claude asks for the niche/topic since none was provided, then explains it will list available repos for the user to pick from before running anything. Should NOT auto-select repos or auto-run the pipeline.
expectations: Claude asks the user to provide a niche or topic before proceeding
Claude does NOT auto-select repos or run the pipeline without user input
Claude explains or references the researcher skill as Step 1 of the pipeline
Claude mentions /hook as the next step after the brief is reviewed

evals.expected_output: Claude uses the researcher skill, runs python -m skills.researcher --list to show available repos, then asks the user which repos to research. Does not skip the repo-selection step.
expectations: Claude attempts to run `python -m skills.researcher --list` to show available repos
Claude asks the user to select which repos to research before running
Claude identifies the niche as 'AI agents' from the command argument
Claude shows the correct command syntax including --niche and --repos flags
Claude does not run the research pipeline without user confirmation of repo selection

evals.prompt: research the microsoft/autogen repo, niche is AI agents
evals.expected_output: Claude follows the full confirmation flow: confirms the repo and niche, asks for approval, then shows the exact command it will run. After (simulated) completion, reports the brief file path and recommends /hook as the next step.
expectations: Claude confirms the repo (microsoft/autogen) and niche (AI agents) with the user before running
Claude shows the correct command: `python -m skills.researcher --niche "AI agents" --repos microsoft/autogen`
Claude mentions the output file path pattern: Content-Hub-Vault-V2/10-Research/YYYY-MM-DD_ai-agents_brief.md
Claude mentions /hook as the next step after reviewing the brief
Claude explains what the brief contains (Recommended Video Angle, synthesized sections)
